message.content:
This magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" across the top. A central cartoon man wearing glasses, a light blue shirt, and dark trousers performs a split in mid-air. His feet rest on the side mirrors of two large blue trucks positioned on either side of him. Each truck contains a bearded driver looking forward. Below the man, a smaller orange bus with a circular red logo on its windshield drives forward between the larger trucks. The background is a hazy light blue sky.

At the top, text reads "Agar Saham GoTo Tak Longsor" and "Ambisi Besar Indonesia di COP27". Publication details in the corner include "7-13 NOVEMBER 2022", "RP 50.000", a barcode, and a QR code. Large white text at the bottom reads "KOALISI RAPUH PENYOKONG ANIES," followed by a paragraph starting with "Tiga partai pengusung Anies Baswedan sebagai calon presiden 2024 terbelah soal calon wakil presiden." The man’s facial expression is one of surprise, with wide eyes and an open mouth.
